title: International Wire vs Low-Cost FX Fee Savings Calculator
short_title: Bank Wire vs FX Savings Calculator
meta_description: Compare traditional bank wire transfer fees and hidden 3%–4.5% exchange rate markups against transparent mid-market FX providers like Wise.
lead: Uncover how much hidden bank exchange rate spreads cost your business per transfer and over an entire year.

inputs.label: Bank Exchange Rate Spread (%)
inputs.hint: Commercial banks typically hide a 3.0%–4.5% markup inside the quoted FX rate.

formula_html:
Bank Cost = Wire Fee + Transfer Amount × Bank FX Spread%.

Savings per Transfer = Bank Cost - (Transfer Amount × Low-Cost Provider%), multiplied by your annual transfer count.

faqs.q: Why does my bank say '$0 wire fee' when exchanging currency?
faqs.a: Banks often waive the explicit $25–$45 wire fee while widening the bid-ask exchange rate spread by 3% to 5%. On a $10,000 supplier invoice, a 3.5% FX markup silently costs $350.

faqs.q: How do I check my bank's hidden FX markup?
faqs.a: Compare your bank's quoted rate against the real-time mid-market rate on Google or Reuters at the exact same moment. The percentage gap is your hidden fee.
